title: Slovakian Cheese Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with cheese-filled dumplings served in a light and flaky dough.
instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large bowl, combine flour, water, eggs, and salt to form a dough.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
5. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
6. Place a tablespoon of Slovakian cheese in the center of each circle.
7. Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and press edges together.
8. Fry the dumplings in hot oil for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
9. Drain the dumplings on paper towels.
10. Serve hot with melted butter and a side of your choice.
